_comment: Curated progression economy for the purchase advisor (engine/purchases.py). NONE of this is in any catalog API, and the official player endpoint exposes ownership but never currency balances or prices — so costs/gates/priors are hand-maintained researched constants (verified ~Aug 2026) and WILL drift on balance updates. Treat as approximate: the advisor ranks by meta value and shows cost only as context, so a stale number misinforms the cost label, not the ranking. Candidate for a future patchnotes-fed refresh. See docs/purchase-advisor.md.

power_cost_cumulative._comment: Cumulative cost to REACH a given power level, indexed by level 0..11 (0 and 1 are 0). Cost to upgrade current->target = arr[target] - arr[current]. Classic per-step values; to 9 = 1410 PP + 3090 coins, 9->11 = 2330 PP + 4675 coins.

item_costs._comment: Coin/PP price to buy one item. Gear = the universal Super Rare tier (Epic/Mythic gears are being retired/refunded through 2026, so they're not recommended). Hypercharge is a straight coin buy outside events.

new_brawler_credits._comment: Starr Road credit cost to unlock a brawler, keyed by the reference `rarity` name. Approximate/balance-sensitive.

power_gates._comment: Power level at which each purchase typically becomes available. Advisory only — surfaced as a 'requires Power N' note and used to fold the power-upgrade cost into a gated item's cost; never a hard filter.

impact_priors._comment: 0..1 prior for how much win-rate a purchase kind unlocks, multiplied by the brawler's meta strength to rank. A first gadget/star power is build-defining; a second is flexibility (only one star power equips at a time), so it's valued lower. Tunable.

hypercharge_availability._comment: Which brawlers have a hypercharge to buy. The API can't tell 'no hypercharge exists' from 'exists, not owned', and no catalog lists them. mode 'all_except' treats every Power-11 brawler as eligible unless named in `list` (matches the ~all-brawlers-have-one reality as of 2026, and only fires at Power 11 so a brand-new HC-less brawler is unlikely to trip it); flip to mode 'only' with an explicit `list` for conservative, under-covering behavior. Maintain from release notes.
